definitions.gloss: sea route, shipping lane, air route
definitions.explanation: A regular route used by ships or aircraft for transportation. Covers both maritime and aviation routes, though the maritime sense is more traditional.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{航路|こうろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{三便|さんびん}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are three sailings per week on this route.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{航路|こうろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The route was changed due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{江戸|えど}→江戸：19369_edo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧⟦{海上|かいじょう}→海上：09799_kaijou⟧{航路|こうろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{物流|ぶつりゅう}→物流：05137_butsuryuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{要|かなめ}→要：19357_kaname⟧だった。
examples.english: During the Edo period, the sea route connecting Osaka and Edo was vital for logistics.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for both sea and air routes, though historically the word referred to maritime routes. In modern Japanese, ⟦{航空|こうくう}→航空：02798_koukuu⟧⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧ is more common for air routes specifically.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{海上|かいじょう}→海上：09799_kaijou⟧{航路|こうろ}: maritime route
- {航路|こうろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open a route
- {航路|こうろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧: to change the route
- ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧{航路|こうろ}: regular/scheduled route
- {航路|こうろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧: route safety
